provenance.post_title: Inside Pathfinder Tokens: Character Gallery for Foundry VTT
provenance.asset_description: A screenshot taken within Foundry VTT. In the background, a group of goblins camp within the remains of an overgrown church. In the foreground, the Character Gallery application is open, with a filter set to show any piece of art tagged with the “Goblin” ancestry.
